name: spellkave_hand_over_role
label: Hand over role
description: Commit one reviewed subject replacement through guarded apply as the caller. Preserve binding, presence, extent and expiry. Personal consent and NPC holds never transfer. Completion requires a server receipt; reuse the same request UUID to reconcile a lost response.

argumentGates: The server checks old/new D-6 coverage for this binding; the commit also checks reviewed digests, incarnation/revision, expiry and the one-row subject-only envelope.
limitations: Discovery is a conservative capability superset and cannot authorize a transfer or reveal an unauthorized briefing.
